question: What should come in the place of blank number 5?
solution:
The correct answer is '**Relevant**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage describes an appreciation for ancient tales that still have the power to **"ignite the imagination of a new generation."**
 
• "**Relevant**" (प्रासंगिक/सार्थक) means closely connected or appropriate to what is being done or considered. In this context, it suggests that even though the books are old, their themes and stories still matter and connect with modern readers.
 
• "**Dull**" (Option 1) and "**Boring**" (Option 3) are negative descriptors that would prevent a book from "igniting the imagination."
 
• "**Irrelevant**" (Option 4) is the exact opposite of what the narrator feels; they are experiencing a "rush of awe," which only happens when something feels meaningful or significant.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

Complete Passage Segment: *The used bookstore was not merely a location where one might purchase books; it was a refuge. The air was thick with the earthy, rich smell of paper and dust, an odd fragrance which was at once soothing and (1) overwhelming__. I would spend hours there, running my fingers over the spines of ancient, forgotten books that stood on the shelves. Each novel was another world to discover, and I finally removed a leather-bound book with an odd, yellowed title. Its pages were dry and (2)__fragile__ . to the touch, as if one careless turn would make them disintegrate. As I picked up to read the opening lines, the words didn't merely speak a tale-they whisked me off to a whole different world, a place of magical creatures, gallant heroes, and secret spells. The vocabulary was old-fashioned, but impossibly (3)__vivid__, describing gaudy pictures in my head that were more real than the creaky aisles surrounding me. I was amazed by the imagination of the writer, a well that was presumably truly (4)__boundless__. I felt a rush of awe, an appreciation that these tales, as ancient as they were, remained supremely (5) __relevant__ and capable of igniting the imagination of a new generation.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Universal Themes:** Stories that remain relevant across generations often touch on timeless human experiences like heroism, mystery, and wonder.
 
• **Igniting (प्रज्वलित करना):** Used metaphorically here to mean to provoke or trigger a sudden, strong interest or emotion.
 
• **Synonyms for Relevant:** Pertinent, germane, applicable, significant.
